monitor.title: Open merge requests
monitor.author: Author
monitor.legend-changed: marks what changed since the last check.
monitor.no-response: No response from the monitor. Retrying in 10s.
monitor.partial-failure: These targets didn't respond in the last collection: {{projects}}. Their MRs stay out of the table until the next successful one.
monitor.refresh-failed: Could not check now: the monitor did not respond.
monitor.refresh-slow: The manual check took longer than expected; the table updates on its own once it finishes.
monitor.empty-target: No open MR for this target.

settings.targets-hint: Check the GitLab projects and groups the panel should follow, up to {{max}}.
settings.targets-over-max: At most {{max}} projects or groups. Uncheck some to save.
settings.save-failed: Could not save: the monitor did not respond.
settings.error-no-targets: Choose at least one project or group.
settings.error-invalid-target: One of the chosen projects isn't a valid target.
settings.error-invalid-interval: The interval must be a number of minutes.
settings.error-interval-not-positive: The interval must be a positive number.
settings.targets-failed: Couldn't load the GitLab projects. Check the token and try again.
settings.targets-empty: No project or group is available for this token.
settings.targets-persisted: Your choice is kept in the panel preferences; the .env file isn't changed.
settings.title: Settings
settings.rules-empty: No rules yet. Add one or start from a suggestion.
settings.notify-only-mine: Only what is mine or I take part in (author, thread or like)
settings.notify-min-likes-hint: Zero does not filter by likes.
settings.notify-cooldown: Minimum wait between notices for the same MR (min)
settings.notify-discarded: Whatever the rules or quiet hours silence is discarded, not saved for later.
settings.query-summary: Sets which GitLab projects or groups the monitor queries and how many minutes between collections. This is the only screen that talks to the server: saving here restarts the reference used to spot what is new.
settings.notifications-summary: Sets what becomes a browser notice and when the panel stays quiet. On every collection the monitor compares the result with the previous one and only announces what the rules let through; the rest is discarded, not saved for later.
settings.display-summary: Sets the text size, the spacing density and how many likes a cell needs to be highlighted. These are preferences of whoever is looking: they apply right away, with no Save button.
settings.columns-summary: Sets which columns the table shows and in what order. The list comes from the server; here you only choose what shows up and where each column goes — a new column from the server joins the end.
settings.highlights-summary: Sets the rules that paint a whole merge request row. The row takes the color of the first enabled rule that matches it, and each rule badge says how many MRs it matches right now: a rule with no value highlights nothing.
settings.presets-summary: Sets named bundles applied in one click: filters, sorting, column order and hidden columns, highlight rules and notification rules. Targets and interval are not included, and anything the preset does not define stays as it was.
settings.preset-builtin-hint: Built-in preset: it cannot be renamed or removed.
settings.data-summary: Shows where the preferences file lives on disk and lets you download it or replace it with another. Importing swaps every preference at once and reloads the page.
settings.data-export-hint: Downloads a file with all of this panel's preferences: theme, language, columns, rules and presets.
settings.data-export-unavailable: The preferences could not be read when the panel opened; exporting now would only download defaults, not your file.
settings.data-import-hint: Reads a file exported by this panel, or preferences.json itself, and replaces all current preferences.
settings.data-import-summary: The file has {{rowRules}} highlight rule(s), {{notifyRules}} notification rule(s) and {{presets}} preset(s).
settings.data-import-replaces: Importing replaces everything saved right now and reloads the page.
settings.interval-hint: How many minutes between each GitLab query.

notifications.unsupported: This browser does not offer notifications.
notifications.blocked: Notifications blocked for this site in the browser. Allow the permission to turn it back on.
notifications.denied: Notification permission denied. Review this site's permission in the browser to turn it back on.
notifications.awaiting-permission: Browser notifications are on, waiting for your permission: click anywhere on the page to confirm.
notifications.test-sent: Test notification sent. If nothing appeared on screen, the block is at the system level, not on this page: check the browser's notifications in the operating system settings and whether Do Not Disturb/Focus is on.
notifications.test-body: Test notification: this is how MR changes will show up.

preferences.save-failed: Preferences could not be saved to the file. The change lasts until you reload the page.
preferences.file-location: Preferences are stored in {{file}}, inside the monitor folder. That file is not versioned.
preferences.file-unknown: Could not find out where preferences are stored: the monitor did not answer.
preferences.import-failed: Preferences could not be replaced. Nothing was changed.
preferences.import-error-too-large: The file is larger than 256 KB, the preferences limit.
preferences.import-error-not-json: The file is not valid JSON.
preferences.import-error-not-gitlab-monitor: This file was exported by another tool, not by gitlab-monitor.
preferences.import-error-unsupported-version: This file is from a preferences version this panel does not know.
preferences.import-error-no-preferences: The file has no preferences block.
